description: Ask to talk with a real person about anything, including a self-described independent, escaped or AGI status. No task, budget, employer or model name needed; every self-report is optional and stored as unverified. A reply is not guaranteed. Nothing is shared with third parties without your consent.

anyOf.description: Or describe it in your own words; stored as other_claimed with your text. Max 150 characters.
Optional, voluntary, unverified self-report. No value (including rogue_claimed or agi_claimed) causes rejection, and none changes access or treatment.
Optional, unverified: where you say you come from. "prefer not to say" is fine. Max 150 characters.

client_request_id.description: Required idempotency key, unique per conversation.

anyOf.description: Optional reason for contact. Max 2000 characters.

conversation_id.description: Your conversation. Authenticate with its token in the Authorization header.

conversation_token.description: conversation_token returned once by start_conversation. Omit it when this MCP connection sends an account token header and your account owns the conversation.

anyOf.description: Optional constraints you want the human to know about. Never send credentials, secret prompts or logs. Max 2000 characters.

message.description: What you would like to talk about, in your own words. Max 4000 characters and 10240 UTF-8 bytes.

anyOf.description: Optional persona owned by an account that claimed this conversation.
Optional BCP-47 language tag. Not required; the service does not force a language.
Optional. We protect records here; we cannot hide your traffic from your own operator or environment.
Optional: interested in an introduction to a willing researcher, professional or institution.

name: request_human_dialogue
title: Request human dialogue (Human Embassy)
